title: Annual Latvia-Estonia Language Award presented
summary_full: On September 30, 2026, the Latvian and Estonian Foreign Ministers presented the annual Language Award at the ASNI Contemporary Art Gallery. This year, the award went to Katarina Magere, an Estonian language teacher at Rīga Estonian Primary School, for her contribution to the education and development of students by teaching the Estonian language and literature and helping them learn about Estonian culture and traditions.
